decision: Sam's explicit decision of 2026-11-09 in Claude Code session f804490c: "前端測試提案全部批准，TASK-025 可以開始", answering the consolidated proposal in implementation/P2_task024_client.md: 6 new jsdom cases (4 in the new purchasingApprovals.test.js, 1 in purchasingPurchaseOrderForm.test.js, 1 in client/test/services/purchasing.test.js) and 2 changed existing cases (the lookupApprovers mock in purchasingPurchaseOrderForm.test.js and the TASK-021 navigation pin), in the existing client unit job on every PR. Other pinned files are unchanged re-pins of purchasing-task018.json and purchasing-task021.json, which these changes invalidate as whole receipts, plus support pins for the new and changed pages. This decision does not authorize the agent to publish the digest
purpose: The my-approvals page requests only the actor's pending list with paging and search and links to detail; the detail page shows the fixed approval snapshot, not the live PO, and shows decision controls only for allowedActions plus purchasing.approval; a failed decision keeps the reason, clears the password and retries an uncertain result with the same action and eventId; the settings page sends version, reason and password through the signed update and keeps the reason after an error; submit with approval on requires an approver and sends it; the TASK-018 to TASK-021 client behaviour stays pinned
data: No database or network: mocked services, real discovered pages, and small inline objects of at most 1 approval and 1 line. No fixture files
thresholds: All cases pass; coverage floors unchanged; no timing threshold
trigger: Routine correctness regression on every PR and push to main, in the existing client test job
cost: Measured locally on 2026-11-09: the 7 Purchasing client test files, 121 cases, run in a few seconds together; the new file's 4 cases take about 0.1 s. CI not measured, estimated under 2 s added. No new job and no capacity workload
